evals.prompt: The phone recording shows the hotspot pill in the status bar. Replace it with a normal Wi-Fi bar.
evals.expected_output: Rebuilds the status bar per frame from the frame's background colour plus glyphs from a clean take sampled when it shows them; keeps the time consistent; verifies first and last frames.
assertions: Fills with each frame's own background
Uses glyphs from a clean take

evals.prompt: Use version B before 20 seconds and version A after.
evals.expected_output: Finds where the two versions agree with --compare and cuts there; reports the difference value at the cut.
assertions: Reports the difference at the cut

evals.expected_output: Applies a light luma unsharp mask once on the picture master and re-muxes soundtracks; no 4K render unless asked.
assertions: Does not jump to a 4K render
